# VideoForge

> Self-hosted video editing, asset-free motion graphics and FFmpeg rendering.
> The browser Studio and agent API use the same timeline. No agent-supplied code is executed.

## Documentation

## Discovery

Agent skill (how to connect, edit well and render): SKILL.md, served beside this file.
No key yet? POST BASE/api/agent/keys, or GET BASE/api/agent/signup, creates one with no sign-in.

Use Authorization: Bearer <scoped-key>. BASE is the user's API server, which may
be different from this frontend's origin. Read-capable keys can GET:

- /api/capabilities: limits, property ranges, ops, templates and shape schema
- /api/motion/templates: template catalog
- /api/graphics/schema: JSON Schema for shapes

## Creative loop

1. Discover capabilities; never invent operation names.
2. POST /api/projects with {name,timeline:{clips:[]}}.
3. GET /api/projects/:id; retain updatedAt.
4. POST /api/projects/:id/timeline/ops with {ops:[...],dryRun:true,expectedUpdatedAt}.
5. Submit the same batch without dryRun, retaining expectedUpdatedAt.
6. Use committed createdClipIds to refine layers.
7. Inspect GET /api/projects/:id/state?t=1 and /frame?t=1&width=640.
8. POST /api/renders with {projectId}; poll /api/renders/:jobId.
9. Download /api/renders/:jobId/download only when status is done.

All mutating operations require write scope or higher. Keys/visibility/live-watch
management require admin. Keep owner keys out of agent prompts and client code.

## Motion graphics

add_motion_template args:
{template:"lower-third",title:"Ada Lovelace",subtitle:"Pioneer of computing",
 color:"#f6a447",start:0,duration:4}

Templates: lower-third, title-card, callout, kinetic-type, countdown.
Duration: 0.5..60 seconds. Kinetic type: up to 8 words.
Templates compile to editable clips. Text uses an aspect-ratio-aware fit estimate;
inspect long text in rendered frames.

add_shape_clip args:
{id:"badge",start:0,duration:4,x:0.5,y:0.5,
 shape:{type:"rectangle",width:0.35,height:0.2,fill:"#f6a447",
 stroke:"#ffffff",strokeWidth:2,radius:24}}

Shape types: rectangle, ellipse, line.
Dimensions: fractions of the canvas. strokeWidth/radius: output pixels.
Colors: #rrggbb or transparent. Shape geometry and colors are static.
Transform animation: x, y, scale, rotation, opacity using clip-local keyframes.

stagger_clips args:
{clipIds:["a","b","c"],start:0,delay:0.15}

## Safety and limits

- Up to 100 ops per atomic batch, 200 clips per timeline, 64 keys per property.
- On any failed op, nothing in the batch is persisted (422, failedIndex).
- On a stale guarded ops write, fetch/re-plan (409, REVISION_CONFLICT).
- POST /api/projects/:id/timeline/validate with {timeline} checks without saving.
- Dry-run generated IDs are provisional. Committed createdClipIds are final.
- Media draws first, shapes next, text last. There is no general z-index.
- No arbitrary SVG paths, Lottie, expressions, 3D, nested scenes or motion blur.
- Inspect actual rendered frames: font metrics and sampled easing can vary.
